Exact direct MaplePool 0x356b8d89c1e1239cbbb9de4815c39a1474d5ba7d; constructor-bound manager 0x0cda32e08b48bfddbc7ee96b44b09cf286f9e21a and underlying USDT 0xdac17f958d2ee523a2206206994597c13d831ec7. Pool checkCall delegates permission/pause checks to its constructor-bound manager; the independently resolved manager implementation checks the owner/lender permission through poolPermissionManager and global pause state. The configured withdrawalManager and its current queue/window, cancellation eligibility and liquidity rules remain authoritative and can revert. Its address/implementation was not freshly obtained; no specific queue type, immediate exit or cancellation guarantee is asserted.

Ordinary cancellation/reduction of an existing redemption request, not a privileged callback at this pool root. For a third-party caller the pool first consumes requested shares of existing owner-to-caller allowance (maximum allowance remains unchanged), even if fewer shares are returned. Pool calls manager.removeShares, whose onlyPool modifier permits this internal pool-to-manager call, then configured withdrawalManager.removeShares(shares,owner). Returned shares and cancellation availability depend on configured withdrawal manager; no underlying asset withdrawal, caller-directed recipient, min-return or deadline is provided. Shares remain attributed to owner; this method does not grant an operator or change an allowance upward.
